summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Yuma, Colorado. It identifies the City of Yuma as a Home Rule Municipality and the most populous city in Yuma County, Colorado, United States. It gives the population as 3,524 at the 2010 census.
one_line: Yuma, Colorado is a Home Rule Municipality and the most populous city in Yuma County, with 3,524 residents at the 2010 census.
key_facts: The City of Yuma is a Home Rule Municipality.
The City of Yuma is the most populous city in Yuma County, Colorado, United States.
The population of the City of Yuma was 3,524 at the 2010 census.
